Revenue by region is omitted because revenue in Japan exceeds 90% of consolidated revenue. The two major customers are Daiso Industries Co., Ltd. (¥22,423 million, 32.8% of consolidated revenue) and Seria Co., Ltd. (¥9,051 million, 13.3%). Daiso Industries, the largest customer, is unlisted and is not eligible for registration in this encyclopedia, so it is not included among related companies.
